name: neuroflash

one_liner.value: AI platform for content, branding, and digital twins. Create content and predict its impact in advance. 85–98% accuracy. GDPR-compliant.
also_acceptable: AI that creates content. And proves that it works.

tasks.note: 'market research' is the Digital Twins audience testing the site describes.

can_execute.note: No sentence on the pages read says it publishes, sends or schedules, and none says it only drafts. Closest wording: 'Maximum confidence BEFORE you publish or invest.'

multi_agent.note: The words agent, multi-agent and orchestration do not appear on the pages read.

integrations.note: Claude and Cursor are named as MCP targets ('neuroflash inside Claude, Cursor, etc.'); Chrome and Firefox as browser extensions (FAQ). The header has an 'Integrations' menu whose entries were not visible in the text reading, so this list may be incomplete.

pricing.note: Essential plan. free_tier is true because of a trial ('7-day free trial'), not a free plan. Monthly-billed prices were not on the page.

hq_location.note: neuroflash GmbH, Wulfsdorfer Weg 100. The about page also says 'with headquarters in Hamburg'.

notes: The site is bilingual; the og:description is German ('7 Tage kostenlos testen.') while the page text read was English. Not a self-described agent product: it is an AI content assistant, included for contrast on can_execute.
